name: Heavy-Duty Wire Scrubber Dishwashing Mitts – Heat Resistant Steel Wire Cleaning Gloves for Pots, Pans, Grills, and Kitchen Tasks
description: Elevate your kitchen cleaning routine with the ultimate heavy-duty Steel Wire Cleaning Mitt. This multi-functional glove is engineered for those who want to clean faster without sacrificing hand protection.Constructed with a specialized textured wire weave, these mitts provide powerful scrubbing action for cast iron, stainless steel, and oven racks without the need for separate sponges. The inner lining is designed for comfort, while the exterior is tough enough to tackle the most demanding household chores. Whether you are scrubbing a greasy wok in the sink or pulling a warm plate out of the microwave, these gloves offer the grip and durability you need.Key Features & ResponsibilitiesSuperior Scouring Power: The integrated wire mesh easily removes rust, oil stains, and stubborn charred food from cookware.Hand Protection: Shields your skin from harsh detergents, hot water, and abrasive surfaces.Heat Resistance: Safe for handling warm dishes and trays (note: not intended for long-term high-heat oven use).Non-Slip Grip: The textured surface ensures a firm hold on slippery, soapy dishes and glassware.Eco-Friendly & Durable: Reusable and easy to rinse clean, reducing the need for disposable plastic sponges.Versatile Use: Perfect for the kitchen, outdoor grills, bathroom tiles, and even car wheels.
